description:
H200+ Adult Mountain Bike

Aluminum Frame - Light, sturdy, durable and more speedy.
3/6-Spoke XC Wheel - Reduce wind resistance and increase strength.
Front Suspension Fork - Smoother and more comfortable riding experience.

Professional Drivetrain - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.
Dual Disc Brakes - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.

Rugged and Durable

Hiland H200+ features a durable, ultralight and preservative aluminum frame which is perfect for exploring mountain trails in safety and comfort.

Internal shift cable and brake hose routing can help your cables last longer by protecting them from any environment, reduce wind resistance.

Special Wheel Design

The 3-spoke / 6-spoke wheel features high inertia and advanced aerodynamics for faster speed on flat roads.

26''*1.95'' XC tires are thin and roll fast, have anti-skid patterns, handle pavement, gravel and dirt with ease. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

More Comfortable Riding

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path and enables provide superb shock resistance even on rocky and bumpy terrain.

It therefore effectively reduces obstructive shocks during the ride, thus ensuring that you have an ideal comfortable riding experience.

Professional Drivetrain and Brakes

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, so you always have the right gear for your terrain to enjoy riding.

Dual mechanical disc brakes provide you better durability and stopping power, allowing riders to stop quickly in case of an emergency. Also, it does not damage the rim.

Assembly & Size Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Please don’t assemble the fork BACKWARDS. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

The 26-inch bike suits riders between 5' to 6' tall.

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain offers a wide gear range, giving you more control on climbs and more room for lower speeds on descents, corners and jumps.

Dual Disc Brakes

Dual disc brakes can provide a better braking effect and less affect in rainy days to ensure your safety. Also, it does not damage the rim.

High-Tech Frame

Hiland H200+ features a lightweight and durable aluminum frame which helps you save pedal effort and ride faster.

3/6 Spoke Wheels

3/6-spoke wheels reduce wind resistance and increase strength with a more stylish appearance.
XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials. It has strong grip and puncture resistance.

Master any terrain with the Hiland H200 + Mountain Bike. Featuring 26" x 2.125" wide tires, a 21-speed drivetrain, and lock-out suspension for ultimate trail control.
